Vaibhavi Hospital

Vaibhavi Hospital is a women's and maternity hospital in Taloja Phase 2, Navi Mumbai, led by gynecologist Dr. Vaibhavi Birle. Delivery, NICU, ICU, surgery and diagnostics, all in one building behind Pendhar Metro Station.
